basic_details.job_title: DCPU Dindigul Outreach Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit Dindigul (DCPU Dindigul) has notified 1 temporary Outreach Worker vacancy. Candidates can apply offline by submitting the application in person or by post to the District Child Protection Officer, Dindigul, on or before 30 October 2026. Applicants must be not more than 42 years of age as on 30 September 2026 and have passed the 12th standard or equivalent recognized board/institution alongside good communication skills. The notified remuneration for the post is Rs. 10,592 per month. Selection is carried out through application screening followed by an interview o

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DCPU Dindigul Outreach Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Outreach Worker post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Dindigul Outreach Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30 October 2026, which is within 15 days of the publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th standard or an equivalent recognized board/institution and possess good communication skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 42 years of age as on 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 10,592/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their completed applications along with self-attested certificates either in person or by post to the District Child Protection Officer in Dindigul.

faq.question: Q8. Is this post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: This is entirely a temporary appointment on a contract basis, and candidates cannot claim permanent rights.
